notes.title: Build For Sale Simulator Major Update
notes.content: [h3]🏦 [b]Banking System[/b][/h3][p]A new [b]Bank[/b] tab has been added to the tablet![/p][list][*][p]Track your [b]daily and monthly income/expenses[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Review your [b]transaction history[/b] to see all past actions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Take loans[/b] to purchase more properties and grow faster.[/p][/*][/list][p]💡 [i]Financial planning and expansion are now in your hands! [/i][/p][p][i] [/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/f2e8b764f6f35ca0829733eed8d458435d9cd167.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🎨 [b]Default Graphics Settings[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The game now launches with [b]high graphic settings[/b] and [b]LUMEN enabled[/b], delivering a much more realistic experience.[/p][/*][*][p]If you experience performance issues, you can easily adjust the settings from the [b]Settings Menu[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/b19ba94c308800a0b4e9bae25b566dee25db021b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/a5bcb3ba8f130abf3745f50c4718688ba73bd163.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Fixed [b]continuous rain[/b] issue.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed [b]characters disappearing[/b] during rainy weather.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed [b]ESC key not working[/b] properly in UI navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Resolved various [b]bugs when creating listings[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🪑 [b]New Item[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Streamer Chair[/b] to the [b]Streamer Setup[/b] category. 🎮🖥️[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712624/6e2342995dfe5a2408c6e32ffe3da7214f70fcb7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Thank You![/b] Your feedback is very important to us. Please report any bugs in the [b]Discord[/b] channel or on Steam discussions. 💛[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Auto Save + Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p][b]Highlights[/b][/p][list][*][p]✅ Added [b]Auto Save System[/b] – the game now saves progress automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed [b]Certificate acquisition bug[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ General bug fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Details[/b][/p][list][*][p]Auto Save: Even if you forget to save manually, your progress will now be preserved.[/p][/*][*][p]Certificates: Fixed issue where players couldn’t obtain certificates after completing tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Stability: Minor bug fixes and optimizations under the hood.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Basic Bargaining + Fixes
notes.content: [p][b]Highlights[/b][/p][list][*][p]✅ Added a [b]Basic Bargaining System[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed [b]floating/levitating items[/b] issue.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Resolved [b]ESC not closing the Big Map[/b] problem.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed [b]occasional texture loading issues[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Details[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bargaining: Simple offer–counteroffer flow in customer dialogue. This is v1; improvements will come with feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Physics/Placement: Improved alignment/collision to prevent items from hovering.[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX: ESC now properly closes the Big Map.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics: Optimized texture streaming to prevent missing/failed loads.[/p][/*][/list]
